executiveAssessment.text: Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa currently shows AI Consideration of 71.3% and Scenario Presence of 95.0%, with Reality Coverage at 44.4%. Strongest governed signal: Strong visibility for Leisure Travel. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-08-20), material headline movement is AI Consideration -0.4 pp and Scenario Presence -5.0 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 4 with Portfolio AI Presence 81.3%. Independent Positioning is also strong and does not contradict the Core read; benchmark and index remain suppressed while the peer set stays below five hotels. Overall Core performance remains strong; weakness, where present, is concentrated rather than broad. Management should protect demonstrated strengths, review concentrated attribute gaps, and watch competitive displacement where it already appears in evidence.

positiveSignal.title: Positive Signal
positiveSignal.body: For Leisure Travel searches, Cambridge Beaches Resort & Spa appeared in 79.2% of AI answers, compared with 10.8% for the comparable hotels used in this analysis. That means the hotel was surfaced about 7.3 times as often as the comparable hotels used in this analysis. In practical terms, this is the area where the hotel is showing its clearest visibility advantage versus similar hotels.

secondaryCallout.title: Watch Item
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 95% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 71.3% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
